primary_sources.exact_import: Canonical decreasing V indices, strictness and point-module exponents. The finite Euler-lattice lemma and ramification formula are new written arguments, not imported without proof.

new_written_arguments: A finite coherent Euler-stable module with residue spectrum strictly above -1 lies in V^>-1, by its lowest V grade.
Exact left graph pushforward gives e E_r q(z^j m)=q(z^j E_z m)+(j+1-e)q(z^j m), retaining the transfer shift. Residues (alpha+j+1)/e-1 stay strictly above -1, including nonsemisimple source residues.
Original good lattices survive every nonconstant polynomial recomposition. Tame original-form image stays finite free of ordinary rank deg(h)*rho, even when the composite is nonisolated and non-tame.

A normalized eventually pure composite h(f) forces an original-unit V defect for f at SOME root of h above zero. Canonical primitive factors are therefore genuinely non-tame on the cover and their actual regular quotient level.

The actual trace-square example has nonisolated critical surface but finite original-form image and Catalan pure moments. The A2 x^2 raw quotient is infinite while the full original top image is zero.
essential_boundaries: BOTH complete exceptional MZ cases remain OPEN; all composites of genuinely non-tame primitive fibrations remain in the target.
A primitive defect does NOT prove primitive purity or failure. No reduction to pure primitive phases and no converse V-index reflection is asserted; ramification can kill punctual derivatives.
Finiteness refers to the original-form IMAGE in the full ordinary source, not a raw Brieskorn quotient, actual compact image, generic Fourier rank or total Milnor number.
No all-coefficient-ring lattice promotion, universal machine proof, degree campaign or review gate is introduced.
